Fresh signup business TEST_R13 Biz (state 27-Maharashtra) for Year-end/Final Accounts/Ledger/Sales voucher/E-way; admin@easybooks.in (pro, ERP unlocked) for ERP Parties/Invoice/Quotation/Day Book. PASS: Depreciation & Tax page (period error, dep table WDV 75,000 + SLM pro-rata 17,863.01, post -> JRN voucher shown, warning disappears, PBT refreshes, rate>60 / negative inputs show tax-input-error and disable post, add_back/deductions debounce, tax post 2,10,641 shown), Final Accounts (no error toasts, proprietorship: Depreciation / Net profit before tax / Less provision for income tax; company: Depreciation and amortisation, VI Tax expense (1) Current tax, VII profit, Short-term provisions, asset schedule in PPE note, fa-balanced green, Excel download Final_Accounts.xlsx, Print opens print window), Ledger GSTIN state fill + invalid check-digit toast + saved-details fill (after page reload), ERP Parties GSTIN state/PAN + saved details, Invoice & Quotation GSTIN picker (known selects client, unknown -> new panel -> create selects), invoice-meta-ship_gstin fills ship_name/state/address, E-way bill eway-to-gstin fills name/state/address, finalized ERP invoice appears in Vouchers/Day Book, Reports Day Book and Sales Register while draft does not. FAIL: 2 bugs (Sales voucher new-buyer create resets form; Ledger dialog re-entering same GSTIN in a 2nd new-ledger form without reload does nothing).

ui_bugs.issue: Typing an unknown valid GSTIN (29AAACR5055K1Z3) -> 'Save buyer' creates the Sundry Debtor ledger (toast shown, ledger saved in DB) BUT the party select stays 'Select party' and GST type stays intra (should become inter: company 27 vs buyer 29). RCA: onLedgerAdded -> setLedgers((x)=>[...x,l]) in VoucherEntry.jsx line 142; the useEffect at lines 61-69 depends on [id, pType, ledgers] and calls setF(blank(...)) whenever ledgers changes, wiping the whole form (party, items, gstType) right after pickParty set it. In edit mode it would also re-fetch and overwrite the voucher being edited. Fix: run the init effect only on first ledgers load (e.g. depend on a boolean `ledgersLoaded` / useRef guard) or keep added ledgers in a separate state not in that effect's deps.

On Ledgers page: create ledger with GSTIN 27AAPFU0939F1ZV (saved), then click New Ledger again and type the same GSTIN -> no API call, no toast, nothing filled (state stays 'Not set'). Works only after page reload. RCA: LedgerDialog stays mounted between opens, and `last` ref in useGstinAutofill still equals the previous GSTIN so the effect returns early. Fix: reset last.current when gstin is not 15 chars (e.g. `if (g.length !== 15) { last.current = ''; return; }`), so clearing/reopening the form re-triggers lookup. Same latent issue for any always-mounted form using the hook.

issues: Only preset is 'Proprietor - enter your effective slab rate - 0%' and the rate input is blank, so default tax shows 0 and post is disabled until user types a rate; preset select shows the 0% preset while input is empty - slightly confusing but acceptable
State column mixes formats: new GSTIN-filled parties show '29-Karnataka' while older ones show 'Karnataka'

action_items: HIGH: Fix VoucherEntry.jsx init useEffect (deps include `ledgers`) that resets the form when GstinPicker adds a new ledger; verify party gets selected and GST type flips to inter for 29-Karnataka buyer in a 27-Maharashtra company
MEDIUM: Reset `last` ref in useGstinAutofill when GSTIN is cleared/short so a re-opened LedgerDialog (and other persistent forms) looks up the same GSTIN again
Note: review_request's Karnataka sample 29AAACR5055K1Z5 has a wrong check digit; valid one is 29AAACR5055K1Z3
critical_code_review_comments: GstinPicker.create uses onPicked closure from click-time render; any parent state change during the await (like the ledgers effect above) overwrites. Prefer functional setState in parents (DocEditor already does setF((x)=>...); ItemsForm.pickParty uses `value` closure).

DocEditor GstinPicker onPicked sets client_id but does not clear project_id when the chosen client differs from the selected project's client (the client <select> onChange does this) - can produce client/project mismatch.
LedgerDialog: opening Edit on a ledger that already has a GSTIN triggers a lookup + 'Saved details ... filled in' toast on every open (harmless but noisy).
